answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. The protection comes from the fact that every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, so flooding the jury floods the attacker with its own cost. Consider a thread as the anchor of the cost.
